forum.title: I can't use stm32wba55cg TSC group4
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Dongs

From my understanding on the STM32WBA55C in the 48-pin package, TSC Group 4 cannot be used as a normal standalone touch-sensing group because it has no available sampling IO , a usable TSC group normally needs at least one sampling pin and one channel pin. In a full 4-IO group, this usually leaves 3 usable touch channels after reserving 1 pin for sampling. Since Group 4 cannot provide that sampling function on this package, it should not be counted as a full TSC group for your design. As a result, achieving 12 TSC channels plus 1 SPI and 1 ADC on the UFQFPN48 package is likely very difficult.

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text: I am using the STM32WBA55C 48-pin package, and TSC Group 4 cannot be set as a sampling capacitor. Does this mean I cannot use TSC in Group 4? I plan to use 12 TSC channels, 1 SPI channel, and 1 ADC channel, so please give me some advice.
